<Window x:Class="ExcelPlanner.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ExcelPlanner"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="Excel Planner - Quí Lee" Height="700" Width="1200"
        Background="{DynamicResource SystemControlPageBackgroundAltHighBrush}">

    <Grid>
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Toolbar -->
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="10" Background="Transparent">
            <Button Content="📂 Mở File Excel" Click="OpenFile_Click" Style="{StaticResource ButtonRevealStyle}" Width="120" Margin="0,0,10,0"/>
            <ComboBox x:Name="CboSheets" Width="200" SelectionChanged="CboSheets_SelectionChanged"/>
            <TextBlock x:Name="TxtStatus" Text="Sẵn sàng" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="10,0,0,0" Foreground="Gray"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <!-- Main Content -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="10">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="3*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="1*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Data Grid -->
            <Border BorderBrush="#CCCCCC" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="5" Background="White">
                <DataGrid x:Name="DgData" AutoGenerateColumns="True" IsReadOnly="True" 
                          SelectionMode="Single" SelectionChanged="DgData_SelectionChanged"
                          GridLinesVisibility="All" HeadersVisibility="Column"
                          CanUserAddRows="False" CanUserDeleteRows="False"/>
            </Border>

            <!-- Planning Panel -->
            <Border Grid.Column="1" Margin="10,0,0,0" Background="#F9F9F9" CornerRadius="5" Padding="10">
                <StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="📊 Phân tích & Kế hoạch" FontWeight="Bold" FontSize="16" Margin="0,0,0,10" Foreground="#333"/>
                    
                    <GroupBox Header="Chi tiết dòng chọn" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TxtRowIndex" Text="Dòng: -" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TxtSummary" Text="Nội dung tóm tắt..." TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,5,0,0"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </GroupBox>

                    <GroupBox Header="Gợi ý Biểu đồ" Margin="0,0,0,10">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="TxtChartSuggestion" Text="Chưa có dữ liệu để phân tích." FontStyle="Italic" Foreground="Gray"/>
                            <Button Content="Xem Demo Biểu Đồ" Click="ShowChartDemo_Click" Margin="0,5,0,0" Style="{StaticResource ButtonRevealStyle}"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </GroupBox>

                    <GroupBox Header="Danh sách Task">
                        <StackPanel>
                            <ListBox x:Name="LbTasks" Height="150" DisplayMemberPath="Description"/>
                            <Button Content="➕ Thêm dòng này vào Task" Click="AddTask_Click" Margin="0,5,0,0" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </GroupBox>
                </StackPanel>
            </Border>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="ExcelPlanner.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns:materialDesign="http://materialdesigninxaml.net/winfx/xaml/themes"
        xmlns:local="clr-namespace:ExcelPlanner"
        mc:Ignorable="d"
        Title="Excel Planner - Quí Lee" Height="700" Width="1200"
        TextElement.Foreground="{DynamicResource MaterialDesignBody}"
        Background="{DynamicResource MaterialDesignPaper}"
        TextElement.FontWeight="Medium"
        TextElement.FontSize="14"
        FontFamily="{materialDesign:MaterialDesignFont}">

    <Grid Margin="16">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- Top Bar with Material Design Style -->
        <materialDesign:Card Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,16">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                
                <Button Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignRaisedButton}"
                        materialDesign:ButtonAssist.CornerRadius="8"
                        Content="_Mở File Excel" Click="OpenFile_Click" Margin="0,0,16,0">
                    <Button.Content>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <materialDesign:PackIcon Kind="FileExcelOutline" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Text="Mở File Excel"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Button.Content>
                </Button>

                <ComboBox x:Name="CboSheets" Grid.Column="1" Width="200" 
                          Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignOutlinedComboBox}"
                          materialDesign:HintAssist.Hint="Chọn Sheet" 
                          SelectionChanged="CboSheets_SelectionChanged"/>

                <TextBlock x:Name="TxtStatus" Grid.Column="2" Text="Sẵn sàng" 
                           VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="16,0,0,0" 
                           Foreground="{DynamicResource MaterialDesignBodyLight}"/>
                
                <Button Grid.Column="3" Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignFlatButton}"
                        Content="Lưu Task" Click="SaveTasks_Click"/>
            </Grid>
        </materialDesign:Card>

        <!-- Main Content Area -->
        <Grid Grid.Row="1">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="3*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="1*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!-- Data Grid with Card Style -->
            <materialDesign:Card>
                <DataGrid x:Name="DgData" AutoGenerateColumns="True" IsReadOnly="True" 
                          SelectionMode="Single" SelectionChanged="DgData_SelectionChanged"
                          Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignDataGrid}"
                          GridLinesVisibility="Horizontal"
                          HeadersVisibility="Column"
                          CanUserAddRows="False" CanUserDeleteRows="False"
                          EnableRowVirtualization="True"/>
            </materialDesign:Card>

            <!-- Right Planning Panel -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="16,0,0,0">
                
                <!-- Selected Row Info -->
                <materialDesign:Card Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="Chi tiết dòng đang chọn" 
                                   Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignSubtitle1TextBlock}" 
                                   Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TxtRowIndex" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TxtSummary" TextWrapping="Wrap" 
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource MaterialDesignBodyLight}"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </materialDesign:Card>

                <!-- Chart Suggestion -->
                <materialDesign:Card Padding="16" Margin="0,0,0,16">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="Gợi ý Trực quan hóa" 
                                   Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignSubtitle1TextBlock}" 
                                   Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="TxtChartSuggestion" TextWrapping="Wrap" 
                                   FontStyle="Italic" Foreground="Gray" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                        <Button Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignOutlinedButton}"
                                Content="Xem Demo" Click="ShowChartDemo_Click" HorizontalAlignment="Left"/>
                    </StackPanel>
                </materialDesign:Card>

                <!-- Task Manager -->
                <materialDesign:Card Padding="16">
                    <StackPanel>
                        <TextBlock Text="Danh sách Công việc (Task)" 
                                   Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignSubtitle1TextBlock}" 
                                   Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                        
                        <ListBox x:Name="LbTasks" Height="200" BorderThickness="0" 
                                 ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                            <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                                <DataTemplate>
                                    <CheckBox IsChecked="{Binding IsDone}" 
                                              Content="{Binding Description}" 
                                              Margin="0,4"
                                              CommandParameter="{Binding}"
                                              Checked="Task_Checked" Unchecked="Task_Unchecked"/>
                                </DataTemplate>
                            </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                        </ListBox>

                        <Button Style="{StaticResource MaterialDesignRaisedButton}"
                                materialDesign:ButtonAssist.CornerRadius="8"
                                Content="_Thêm Task từ dòng này" Click="AddTask_Click" 
                                Margin="0,16,0,0" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch">
                            <Button.Content>
                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                    <materialDesign:PackIcon Kind="Plus" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                                    <TextBlock Text="Thêm Task"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                            </Button.Content>
                        </Button>
                    </StackPanel>
                </materialDesign:Card>
            </StackPanel>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>
arguments.task_description: Nâng cấp giao diện MainWindow.xaml sang Material Design đầy đủ
